remarks: Discover the epitome of luxury living in this stunning rental townhome, built in 2023 within a private gated association in the heart of downtown Greenwich. The perfect balance of elegance & comfort, showcasing unparalleled attention to detail. Culinary enthusiasts will love the gourmet kitchen, perfect for cooking & entertaining, while the expansive family room, a welcoming space for relaxation. Retreat to the opulent primary suite, complete with multiple walk-in closets, and luxury bathroom. Go outside to your own private fenced yard or indulge in your individual rooftop deck. With Greenwich Ave seconds away, you'll have easy access to all the vibrant dining, shopping, & entertainment options downtown!
